svg.title: Comparison Venn figure for Series C question 84
svg.desc: Editorial reconstruction of independently published four-set reasoning figure, not a verified scan of the Series C booklet. Rectangle represents males, triangle educated, circle urban, square civil servants. Number 13 lies inside rectangle and square but outside circle and triangle. Number 7 lies inside square only. Number 4 lies in circle, rectangle and triangle. This is a comparison study diagram, not a certified original illustration.
svg.text: Illustrative comparison from separate sources · NOT a verified Series C booklet scan · Ungraded
